model: L-STAT network thermostat / room operating unit (Modbus RTU)
applies_to: LSTAT-800/801/802 room operating units (all button layouts), user manual version 3.2.8 (document 88085811).
summary: Wall-mounted room panel with LCD, touch buttons, temperature and humidity sensors (plus occupancy on the 801/802 and CO2 on the 802) that works as a Modbus RTU slave for a LOYTEC controller or any master. Everything is in holding registers: button and flag words, sensor readings, display values pushed by the master, set points with limits, offsets and configuration.

addressing.note: Each register is printed with its decimal address and hex equivalent (e.g. 48 / 0x0030). The table starts at register address 0 (present_state, 0x0000), which only exists in 0-based protocol addressing, so these are the wire addresses. 'documented' keeps both forms.

notes: The download link is named 3.2.4 but the document inside is printed as version 3.2.8.
Only function codes 03 (read holding registers) and 06 (write single register) are supported, so multi-register values and strings must be read with FC03 and written one register at a time.

Sensor scaling comes from the manual's value-scaling table: temperatures x0.1 in the configured Modbus unit system (factory default °C; K uses a -2740 offset, °F also x0.1), humidity raw x 0.005 %RH, CO2 1 ppm, voltage x0.1 V.

Set points, set point min/max, display values and offsets are listed raw (scale 1) because their scale depends on the unit chosen in each value's configuration register (addresses 256-351); apply the manual's scaling table for that unit (e.g. °C x0.1, l/s x0.1, inWC x0.001).
Only set_point_0..3, display_value_0..3 and offset_value_0 are listed; the full blocks are set_point 384-399, max 416-431, min 448-463, display values 64-79, offsets 480-488.

Left out: system_time (112-113), Modbus statistics (128+) and firmware/bootloader dates, because the manual does not say which of the two 16-bit halves is the high word; CPU temperature/voltage (55-56), whose scaling is not given.
Configuration and device-setting registers are stored in flash with limited write cycles; do not write them cyclically.

registers.name: present_state
registers.description: Live button and occupancy state (updated in DISPLAY and DIRECT_ACCESS modes).

registers.name: short_pressed
registers.description: Latched short presses and flags; write 1 to a bit to clear it.

registers.name: long_pressed
registers.description: Latched long presses and status flags; write 1 to clear.

bits.12: SPC - a set point was changed locally
bits.13: DOC - device setting or offset changed locally

registers.name: change_flags_set_points
registers.description: Bit n set = set_point_n changed on the panel; write 1 to clear.

registers.name: change_flags_device_settings
registers.description: Device setting changed locally; write 1 to clear.

registers.name: change_flags_offset_values
registers.description: Bit n set = offset_value_n changed; write 1 to clear.

registers.name: manual_occupancy
registers.description: 0 = unoccupied, any other value = occupied (external occupancy input).

registers.name: ir_remote_control_command
registers.description: High byte button code, low byte remote id of the last IR command.

registers.name: sensor_value_0 internal temperature
registers.description: Assumes the default Modbus unit system °C (config_flags MU = 1).

registers.name: sensor_value_1 external temperature
registers.description: Sensor wired to EB3 and GND; default MU = °C assumed.

registers.name: sensor_value_2 relative humidity
registers.description: Raw x 5 x 10^-3.

registers.name: sensor_value_3 dew point
registers.description: Default MU = °C assumed.

registers.name: sensor_value_5 amount CO2
registers.description: LSTAT-802 models only.

registers.name: display_value_0
registers.description: Value written by the master for display; scaling per its configuration (256+).

registers.name: display_value_1
registers.description: As display_value_0.

registers.name: display_value_2
registers.description: As display_value_0.

registers.name: display_value_3
registers.description: As display_value_0.

registers.name: modbus_parameter
registers.description: Bits 13-12 parity, 11-8 baud code, 7-0 slave address. Takes effect after reboot.

registers.name: config_flags
registers.description: Bits 9-8 MU Modbus unit (0 K, 1 °C, 2 °F); 11-10 display unit; bit 0 reboot.

registers.name: set_point_0
registers.description: Signed; scaling follows the unit set in set point config (320+). Default 220.

registers.name: set_point_1
registers.description: Signed; scaling follows its set point configuration.

registers.name: set_point_2
registers.description: Signed; scaling follows its set point configuration.

registers.name: set_point_3
registers.description: Signed; scaling follows its set point configuration.

registers.name: offset_value_0
registers.description: Offset added to its sensor value; same scaling as that sensor.

registers.name: product_code_string
registers.description: Model / product code text.

integration.summary: Read the sensor block 48-54 with FC03 and the button/flag words 0-5; write display values (64+) and read back set points (384+) that the user adjusts. Clear latched flags by writing 1 to the bit.

minimum_registers.why: Which set points the user changed

integration.enable: No enable step; the panel answers as a slave at address 1 out of the box. Change address/baud/parity in EDIT mode on the panel or in modbus_parameter (176), then reboot.
quirks: Only FC03 and FC06: no FC16 multi-register writes.
Temperatures follow the Modbus unit flag (K, °C or °F) in config_flags, not the display unit.
Latched press and change flags stay set until the master writes 1 to them.
setup: Factory default: address 1, 57600 baud, no parity, 2 stop bits.
Built-in 120 ohm terminator: switch it on only at the last device on the bus.
Up to 16 L-STATs per LOYTEC controller; each needs a unique address.
gotchas: The device has no clock battery: the master must set system time after every reboot.
Display range is -999..9999; larger values are shown shifted.

verified.method: independent re-check of every register against the source PDF
